content: Mosquitto is the lightweight, single-threaded, minimal-footprint choice ideal for small/self-hosted IoT deployments; EMQX is a distributed/clustered broker for large-scale industrial IoT and (as of v5.9+) requires a license for multi-node clustering (BSL 1.1). For a single-greenhouse deployment, if MQTT is used at all it should be self-hosted Mosquitto, not EMQX.
